name: John Davis
source:
John is the main character of this story. An all-around average guy, though he has a few surprises hidden up his sleeve, such as an alien device or magical heritage. He would rather spend most of his time playing video games instead of studying. Surprisingly good at speaking different languages and making new friends.

[In game description]
